findings.message: tests/test_oi1486_concurrent_result_writers.py:89-91 and tests/test_oi1486_concurrent_result_writers.py:172-175 join threads with timeout=60 but do not assert thread completion; a future deadlock could leave a daemon thread blocked while the test still passes.

residual_risk: The new flock protection is advisory and serializes only writers that use slot_lock; non-cooperating writers can still interleave with guarded read-check-write sequences.
